Name: Sediment Sorter
Author: brightonmorris1
Description:
The sediment sorter is a PFM machine that will turn your [s]useless[/s] extra materials into the base ores of the game! 

It unlocks at mining level 6 and requires 8 iron, 3 gold, and a battery to craft. The sorter accepts inputs of 3 clay, 33 stone, or one earth crystal and outputs ore randomly selected from a weighted list.

The machine also has a chance to fail and just output some of the materials you put in it, but most of the time it succeeds. (﻿earth crystals are the best input, but take longer to process and do not output coal)

It is also animated while working, because I have too much free time. 

[b]NOTE:[/b] While not required, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063?tab=description]automate[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMautomate[/url] make this machine much less tedious to babysit, and are highly recommended.
